{"metadata":{"description":"Unofficial: drive your own DeepSeek Harness (dsh) as a native VS Code chat agent, beside Claude Code and Codex.","id":"gh:1333538693","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"vscode-deepseek-harness","slug":"kalynnka/vscode-deepseek-harness","topics":["ai-agent","chat-participant","deepseek","dsh-plugin","vscode-extension"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Unofficial: drive your own DeepSeek Harness (dsh) as a native VS Code chat agent, beside Claude Code"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" drive your own DeepSeek Harness (dsh) as a native VS Code chat agent, beside Claude Code and Codex."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# vscode-deepseek-harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文文档 · English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> [!WARNING]
> **Breaking change since v0.0.8:** the extension will no longer start a DSH process au"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"tomatically. You must launch and manage DSH yourself—for example, run `dsh web` in an external termi"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"nal or as a service you manage. The extension will only attach to the server at `deepseekHarness.url"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"` (default: `http://127.0.0.1:3080`). Once DSH is running, use **DeepSeek Harness: Reconnect** if th"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"e extension has stopped retrying."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"An unofficial VS Code extension that registers DeepSeek Harness as a **chat session target** in VS C"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ode's native agent sessions view — the same surface that hosts Claude Code and Codex — rather than s"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"hipping another webview chat panel."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Status: **M0–M5 implemented.** A VSIX builds, installs and activates with its proposed APIs granted."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- docs/plans/0001-vscode-chat-session-provider.md — architecture decision, API mapping, and mileston"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"es.
- docs/gaps.md — what the chat UI wanted, what `/api` could not give it, and what was done inste"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"
- docs/gaps.md — what the chat UI wanted, what `/api` could not give it, and what was done instead."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Using it"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**dsh answers in the same chat panel Copilot does.** There is no second sidebar and no webview: the "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"panel above is VS Code's own, and the reply in it came from the `dsh` on this machine."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Which agent answers is a picker at the bottom of the composer, reading **Local** in a default instal"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"l. Click it and choose **DeepSeek Harness** — from then on, everything you type in that chat goes to"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" your harness. The chip stays until you change it, so this is a per-conversation choice rather than "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"arness. The chip stays until you change it, so this is a per-conversation choice rather than a mode."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Once you are on it, the composer is the ordinary one, and the parts of it that matter here are:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| In the composer | What reaches dsh |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Your editor selection, pinned as a chip | The file, the line range, and the selected lines themsel"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ves |
| A file dragged in, or `#`-referenced | Its path, relative to the session's working directory"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" |
| A pasted image | A real image attachment, when the model accepts one |
| A `/`-line naming a co"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"mmand dsh owns | The command, executed through dsh's own registry — never sent to the model |
| **Mo"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"del** picker | `session.selectModel` — every provider and model your dsh advertises |
| **Reasoning*"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"* picker | The efforts of the selected model, with that model's own default |
| **Permissions** pick"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"er | `read-only` / `workspace-write` / `danger-full-access`, whatever your dsh's preset table holds "},{"id":"p13s8","text":"r | `read-only` / `workspace-write` / `danger-full-access`, whatever your dsh's preset table holds |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"A selection is sent as text because dsh has no structured reference type; a saved file is sent as a "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"path, because dsh has its own read tools and would rather open it than be handed it. Both decisions,"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" and their cost, are in gaps §10."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The **SESSIONS** list on the right is your real dsh session history — the same sessions the `dsh` we"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"b UI shows, because it is the same harness. Opening one rebuilds its transcript; **New Session** sta"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"rts one in your workspace folder."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Sessions list | Your real dsh sessions, live: added, removed, running, and blocked-on-you |
| Tran"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"script | Past turns rebuilt from the session log, with tool cards |
| Live turns | Prose, reasoning,"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" and tool calls streaming as they happen |
| Questions | Answered inline in the chat, blocking exact"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ly as dsh's `ask()` does |
| Approvals | Same, as an *Allow once* / *Reject* prompt |
| Attachments "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"| Your selection with its line range, dropped files, `#`-references, pasted images |
| Model switch "},{"id":"p17s6","text":"| Every provider and model your dsh advertises, read fresh per session |
| Thinking effort | The rea"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"soning efforts of the selected model, with its own default |
| Permissions | The session's preset, s"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"witched through dsh's own `/permission` command |
| Slash commands | dsh's own `plan`, `compact`, `f"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"eedback`, `export`, `permission`, `goal` — proxied from the composer and the Command Palette, never "},{"id":"p17s10","text":"sent to the model |
| Token usage | Per turn, prompt and completion, with the cache read/write split"},{"id":"p17s11","text":" |
| Context | Percent of the model's window on each session row |
| Control | Stop, fork from a cho"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"sen turn, new session in your workspace folder |
| Model switch by command | `/models` in the compos"},{"id":"p17s13","text":"er (or **Switch Model…** in the Command Palette) opens dsh's own catalog |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Nothing in that table is hardcoded. Providers, models, reasoning efforts, titles, token counts and c"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ontext capacity are all read from the running harness, so a model your dsh gains tomorrow appears wi"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"thout an update here."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Slash commands"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"dsh's own slash commands — `/plan`, `/compact`, `/feedback`, `/export`, `/permission`, `/goal`, what"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ever this dsh ships — are **proxied**, not sent. Two surfaces use them:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **In the chat.** A lone `/`-line that names a command dsh owns for that session is intercepted bef"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ore it can reach the model: it is executed through dsh's own command registry, the outcome renders i"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"nline in the chat, no turn is opened and nothing is billed. An unknown `/foo` is *not* intercepted a"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"nd flows to the model as an ordinary prompt — exactly how dsh's own web composer treats it. A `/perm"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ission read-only` typed here is therefore free and instant, not a model call.
- **The `/` dropdown.*"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"* Typing `/` in the composer lists dsh's commands alongside the editor's own, and picking one runs i"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"t through the same proxy. The editor fixes an agent's dropdown list at registration, so these entrie"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"s are contributed statically and filtered live against `commands/list`: a command your dsh does not "},{"id":"p21s9","text":"advertise is hidden, and one it gains beyond the list still runs when typed — it just cannot appear "},{"id":"p21s10","text":"in the dropdown. See gaps §16.
- **Command Palette → DeepSeek Harness: Run Slash Command…** Pick the"},{"id":"p21s11","text":" session to act on (or let it create one in your workspace), pick a command from dsh's live catalog,"},{"id":"p21s12","text":" fill its argument using the input hint dsh advertises, and run it. The picker also offers a free-fo"},{"id":"p21s13","text":"rm entry for any `/command line`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- VS Code **1.133.0** or later.
- A running DeepSeek Harness server. Start `dsh web` yourself, indep"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"endently of VS Code, and let the extension attach to it.
- Proposed APIs enabled for this extension "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"VS Code, and let the extension attach to it.
